metadata.locations_rule: Paths are orientation anchors. Map by actual affected behavior and consumers. A broad directory match on its own does not establish impact.

risk_levels.MEDIUM: Bounded product-facing behavior or compatibility risk.
risk_levels.HIGH: State, integration or financial risk with a material affected scope.
risk_levels.CRITICAL: Trust boundary, money movement or significant integrity risk.

retest_levels.NONE: Ordinary documentation-only change. No product re-acceptance.
retest_levels.LOCAL_ONLY: Focused local unit, component, service or representative local-browser validation is sufficient.
retest_levels.CI_ONLY: Relevant deterministic repository, parity, build or security gate is required.
retest_levels.TARGETED_STAGING: Verify the affected behavior on the actual staged revision using direct API or runtime checks.
retest_levels.TARGETED_HOSTED: Exercise the affected workflow in the deployed browser or product.
retest_levels.PROVIDER_REACCEPTANCE: An authorized real staging provider participates in the affected journey.
retest_levels.CROSS_ROLE_REACCEPTANCE: Multiple distinct C1RCLE actors verify the affected workflow and persisted state.
retest_levels.CROSS_SYSTEM_REACCEPTANCE: Exercise the affected integration across distinct C1RCLE product surfaces.
retest_levels.COMPREHENSIVE_AUDIT: Run the approved broad hosted audit or certification scope.

metadata.level_rule: A default is the baseline for the behavior named in its area. Staging, browser, provider and actor scopes can stack. Keep each applicable check when escalation adds a scope. Cross-system scope covers distinct C1RCLE product surfaces. An external provider alone does not establish cross-system acceptance. CI and local evidence do not replace scoped hosted requirements.
metadata.acceptance_reuse_rule: Use the Acceptance State reuse_policy and each linked item's retest_if. Preserve unrelated PASS evidence. A candidate link means inspect applicability. Mark scoped evidence at risk only for relevant changes, contradiction, expiry or a deliberate certification gate. Keep historical evidence and record exact revisions and scope for new results.
metadata.fixture_rule: Resolve fixture_refs in both fixtures and requirements. Apply the fixture library's selection and promotion rules. Use verified, appropriately mutable synthetic fixtures for changes in state. Keep historical fixtures read-only. Provider actions and deployment require task authorization. Record unavailable setup as a blocker.
metadata.ci_gate_rule: Map the change to existing affected gates. Verify contract parity plus producer/consumer checks for wire changes, relevant security gates for auth changes, and emulator or repository gates for data changes. Batch independent checks and run the required comprehensive final CI gate once on the intended diff when applicable.
change_set_procedure: Identify changed files, behavior, configuration and intended comparison baseline.
Map each change to relevant areas. Trace actual shared consumers when the changed path has multiple callers.
Union relevant acceptance, finding and fixture references. Keep open findings relevant to this diff.
Apply escalation conditions, acceptance invalidation and evidence reuse rules. Include mandatory milestone gates.
Deduplicate and remove unrelated checks. Keep each needed local, CI, staging/API, browser, provider and actor scope.
Write a short RETEST PLAN before broad checks. Record preserved evidence, required authority and missing fixture state.
retest_plan_format: HOSTED REACCEPTANCE — ... (staging/API, browser, provider and actor scope)
comprehensive_audit_triggers: The roadmap calls for comprehensive Guest/Partner hosted audits.
A major milestone group reaches its approved integration acceptance gate.
Access, Promoter and Scanner integration reaches its planned hosted audit.
Experience Quality fixes are complete and broad regression risk warrants the approved audit scope.
An unusually broad architectural or security change makes targeted evidence insufficient.
metadata.final_certification_override: Use past PASS evidence as context. The approved final launch plan can deliberately re-exercise critical workflows regardless of intervening changes.
